_about: Sunday 4 Oct configuration for tools/factory.py. Data only: change this file, not the code; each keeper re-reads it before every start. A 'todo' field marks a value that is still open: `plan` prints every one under its command, and docs/plans/sunday-preflight.md wants none left at 08:40. Placeholders: {python} {until} {params} {duel_ticks} {idle_ticks} {config} {date}. Gates doors_open and clock_running default to true; only the keyless feed and the watchdog opt out. Processes are matched by script basename plus mode token. The dealer bots are on (PR #35 and its follow-up #38 merged: duel lock checked before every accept, pause-safe waits, distinct exit statuses); a dealer step that exits non-zero, or exits 0 without a deal or nothing-to-do marker max_attempts times (default 3), is not relaunched. Dealer commands come from section 7 of the Saturday dealer audit.
notify_cmd_howto: notify_cmd stays null until Thiago sets it on the Mini (the one line is in docs/plans/sunday-night-handoff.md): an argv list; the alert text is appended as its last argument and the factory gives it no secrets, so it must read its own token (the Mini keeps it in ~/.config/telegram-notify.env, which tools/mini/tunnel-agent.sh already uses).

processes.name: feed
processes.note: Keyless public recorder; one copy is enough, so the bus claim stops a second machine from starting it.

processes.name: broker
processes.note: Reads its own key from ~/.bazaar/broker.env (--key-file default). The Market Tests (game hours 14.65 hard, 15.0, 17.0, 19.0, 21.0) come from the schedule; status alerts on any dropped match or no match in a test. --policy stall all day (decided Sunday morning: the maxpairs policy lost everywhere it was tested); it is the stall's exact rule.

processes.name: duel
processes.note: One run per wave (Duels III, then the Final): --duel-ticks comes from the schedule event (12 for both) and flags win over the JSON; --late-poll 4 is the 15 s value from the duel audit; --idle-ticks is the window at 15 s ticks and --until the day's close plus 5 min. The window (165 game min) outlasts a wave even if the game clock runs two game hours per wall hour (216 ticks = 108 game min) and closes before the Final's own window opens (21.483 h), so the two never overlap and a crash is relaunched in either wave.

processes.name: abuela
processes.note: On since #35 and #38 merged (duel lock checked before every accept, pause-safe waits, distinct exit statuses). A step counts as done only on a deal or a nothing-to-do line in this dealer's log. No run starts within 25 game min of a duel wave: a run is 40 ticks, 10 wall min, which is 20 game min if the clock runs at two game hours per wall hour.

steps.label: r3-a1-ret-uncommons
steps.note: RET uncommons are first copies worth 22.5 (book 25 x RET 0.9): cap 22 is the ceiling, strictly inside value. Saturday closes: 22 or less in 20 of 45 deals, 23 or less in 32 of 45. Each one is also the stock for a Pilar resale (L3). Replaces r3-slots-1-3, whose SAL-05 is already ours (plan_empty).

steps.label: r3-a2-ret-commons
steps.note: Fills the L1 slots a1 could not (best three count, the 4th earns about 0). RET commons are worth 9.0, so a close at 9 sits ON the gate: if ladder_points does not move after the first one, drop this step. Closes: 9 or less in 30 of 46, 8 or less in 4 of 46.

processes.name: chato
processes.note: On since #35 and #38 merged (duel lock checked before every accept, pause-safe waits, distinct exit statuses). A step counts as done only on a deal or a nothing-to-do line in this dealer's log. No run starts within 25 game min of a duel wave: a run is 40 ticks, 10 wall min, which is 20 game min if the clock runs at two game hours per wall hour.

steps.label: r3-c1-sal10-fallback
steps.note: OFF by design: Only the one rare Chato sells inside our value (SAL-10 = 70 x 1.3 = 91). Expected credit 0.4 for 86 to 91 P, and it completes the SAL page WITHOUT the page bonus a team trade pays (+3 to +5 points). Enable only if no team has offered SAL-10 by about 11:20 and Hector declines the team buy. Replaces r2-fill-lav09 / r3-slot-1-rare / r3-slots-2-3: LAV-09, SAL-09 and LAV-10 are already ours, so those targets give an empty plan and the factory would mark them done without a trade.

steps.label: r3-c2-sell-cha-uncommons
steps.note: OFF by design: Chamberí only, by hand once a CHA uncommon is ours and no CHA fan has bid for it: CHA uncommon is worth 12.5 to us, Chato bids about 14 (13 to 16). L2 slot at about +0.5 each. Needs the copy to be spare or the last one named (sell:<REF> + --allow-single).

processes.name: pilar
processes.note: On since #35 and #38 merged (duel lock checked before every accept, pause-safe waits, distinct exit statuses). A step counts as done only on a deal or a nothing-to-do line in this dealer's log. No run starts within 25 game min of a duel wave: a run is 40 ticks, 10 wall min, which is 20 game min if the clock runs at two game hours per wall hour.

steps.label: r3-l1-resell-ret-rares
steps.note: Resells the two RET rares bought from Los Picaros (value 63.0, floor 64). She loves RET: a thread on Saturday ran 61, 63, 66, 70, 74, 78. A ref we do not hold yet is skipped; an empty plan counts as done, which is why the retry below exists.

steps.label: r3-l2-resell-ret-uncommon
steps.note: The third L3 slot: one RET uncommon bought from Abuela at 22 or less (value 22.5), sold at 23 or more. Her RET uncommon finals on Saturday were 24 to 26 on long threads.

steps.label: r3-l3-resell-ret-rares-retry
steps.note: Same line later: picks up rares that Los Picaros delivered after the first Pilar step found nothing to sell. Empty plan = done, harmless.

steps.label: r3-l4-resell-ret-uncommon-retry
steps.note: Same line later (it falls after the Duels III window and waits for the gates). Only worth running while Pilar has fewer than three deals this round.

steps.label: r3-cha-sell-uncommons
steps.note: OFF by design: Chamberí, by hand: a CHA uncommon is worth 12.5 to us (book 25 x 0.5); she pays about 16 to 21 for sets she does not love. Use after the CHA fans had their chance (docs/plans/ladder-sunday.md section 5).

steps.label: r3-cha-sell-rares
steps.note: OFF by design: Chamberí, by hand: a CHA rare is worth 35 to us (70 x 0.5); she opens about 47 and ends 50 to 56 for sets she does not love. A CHA fan should pay more: try them first.

steps.label: r3-cha-sell-epic
steps.note: OFF by design: Chamberí, by hand: a CHA epic is worth 90 to us (180 x 0.5); she paid 140 to 199 for epics on Saturday.

processes.name: picaros
processes.note: New dealer: agent/chato.py --dealer picaros buys rares from Los Picaros and never sells him anything. A step counts as done only on a deal or a nothing-to-do line in logs/picaros/<date>.jsonl. Same gates as the other dealers: no run starts within 25 game min of a duel wave.

steps.label: r3-p1-ret-rares
steps.note: RET rares are first copies worth 63.0 (70 x 0.9): cap 62. He opens at 73 and falls to a final at 52 to 63 as we move (62 or less in 47 of 52 Saturday deals; steps of 1 to 2 P ended at 52 to 57). Each rare is resold to Pilar at 64 or more (L3).

steps.label: r3-p2-sal10
steps.note: OFF by design: The third L4 slot, and the only one: SAL-10 (value 91) at 62 or less is inside value (about +0.6), but it completes the SAL page without the page bonus a team trade pays (+3 to +5 points, Saturday: LAT-09 at 88 gave +3.10). Enable only if no team offers SAL-10 by about 11:20 and Hector declines the team buy.

processes.name: rastro_seller
processes.note: Off: 232 listings and no fill on Saturday. --step-ticks 40 keeps the 10 min step-down at 15 s ticks.

processes.name: market_desk
processes.note: Page mode: SAL-10 from a team, El Rastro only, bid 80 -> 110 over 64 ticks (docs/plans/pages-sunday.md). Starts at 09:00, not after the allowance: cash 253 covers the 110 cap, the dealers get +150 at 10:40. No other bids (--no-bids). Every Chato and Picaros SAL-10 step stays off: a second copy is worth 22.75.

processes.name: watchdog
processes.note: Runs status every 60 s and calls notify_cmd when the problem list changes.
